Apple has rolled out the second public beta of iOS 27.2, featuring a completely redesigned Health app.

iOS 27.2 beta brings a redesigned Health app and more

iOS 27.2 will follow iOS 27, which launched officially on September 14. iOS 27.1 is only available for the iPhone Duo.

The first public beta of iOS 27.2 includes the following changes:

  • Apple's redesigned Health app, first unveiled at the iPhone 18 Pro launch event, makes its official debut in this beta.
  • Group FaceTime added to dual capture mode.
  • Siri AI adds support for French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish.
  • Apple TV app profiles arrive on iPhone.
  • Apple Podcasts renames "Up Next" to "Latest Episode". The "Continue Listening" section now appears directly below "Latest Episode". Podcast episode lists also feature backgrounds tinted to match the topic color.
  • Apple Music now uses fewer icon colors on its tabs.

iOS 27.2 is expected to launch officially later this month. iPhone users eager to try the new Apple Health app early can do so through either the developer beta or public beta channels.
